operator_io_quirks: Backtick-quoted DDL identifiers; generated SQL must double-quote ("app_all"), column names like "F23-", "F43+", "M39+" contain '-'/'+' and must be quoted verbatim.
Huge tables: app_events 32.5M rows, events 3.25M, app_events_relevant 3.7M — read_schema must rowid-sample (max_rows_per_table) and never full-scan; original_sizes via count(*).
app_events has composite PK (event_id,app_id) but only event_id is an FK to events; app_id is NOT an FK there (no parent) — FK map must not invent one.
app_events_relevant has TWO FKs (event_id->events_relevant, app_id->app_all) plus composite PK; app_labels has NO PK at all (pk=[]).

Self-ish chain: gender_age.device_id -> phone_brand_device_model2.device_id, but that parent's PK is composite (device_id,phone_brand,device_model) and device_id is NOT unique (89195 distinct of 89200) — FK to non-unique parent.
events_relevant.device_id is 100% NULL (distinct 0, storage null) yet declared INTEGER with FK to gender_age — FK child column with zero non-null values.
events_relevant.timestamp declared DATETIME but storage class is integer (huge negative ints) — declared type contradicts storage; TS dispatches to Number(int elements) not Date.
events.timestamp declared DATETIME, storage text 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS.s' (e.g. '2016-05-01 00:55:25.0') — text-stored date, TS Date fuzzer template must parse this.

app_all.app_id and many device_id/app_id columns hold huge negative int64 values (-9223...); Number fuzzer range [-10^scale,10^scale] with scale from INTEGER (no args) will not reproduce these magnitudes.
sample_submission columns F23-..M39+ are REAL all constant 0.0833 (distinct 1); events_relevant.longitude constant 1.0, latitude {0.0,1.0} — degenerate single-value columns.
phone_brand/device_model contain CJK text (小米, 三星) and spaces ('MI 3','Galaxy Note 2') — String fuzzer CHARSET a-zA-Z0-9() cannot reproduce; literal pool from train SQL may carry them.

gender_age / gender_age_train / gender_age_test / sample_submission all share device_id values (overlapping id spaces) but only gender_age has an FK; no FK between the *_train/_test/_submission tables.
operator_ts_expectations: app_id/device_id/event_id INTEGER -> Number fuzzer, scale=0 (no args), range [-1,1] then int perturb +-1/+-2: produces tiny ints, never the -9.2e18 originals -> implausible values, likely FN on joins/aggregates over these ids.

events.timestamp DATETIME with text elements -> Date fuzzer, template from first parsable element '%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S.%f'-ish; fresh dates formatted by that template — plausible, but p=0.2 element reuse mixes formats.
events_relevant.timestamp DATETIME with int elements -> Number(scale=4) (first element parses as int) -> floats in [-10^4,10^4], not the -9e18 ints; type mismatch vs original.

gender/group TEXT -> String fuzzer over a-zA-Z0-9() with contaminate; original 'M'/'F' and 'M29-31' etc. only survive via 5 sampled originals + literal pool; fresh strings implausible -> FN on gender/group filters.
phone_brand/device_model TEXT -> String fuzzer, CJK originals only via sampled elements; fresh ASCII strings -> FN on brand/model predicates.
is_installed/is_active INTEGER distinct 1-2 -> Number fuzzer draws from {0,1} elements but perturbs to +-1/+-2 -> values like -1,2,3 appear; may break is_active IN (0,1) style predicates (FP/FN).
app_events 32.5M rows: choose_table_sizes caps at 2500, so generated app_events is tiny vs original — join cardinalities and COUNT results wildly off -> FN on count/aggregate gold.
app_labels has no PK: sample_fresh_primary_keys no-op, drop_unique_duplicates no-op -> duplicate (app_id,label_id) rows allowed; original may have ties, TS may over/under-produce duplicates.

FK gender_age.device_id -> phone_brand_device_model2.device_id (non-unique parent): fill_foreign_keys draws from parent's final device_id list with replacement -> many child rows share a parent id, plausible ties; but parent PK composite means device_id repeats anyway.
events_relevant.device_id all NULL: FK child draws from gender_age.device_id (non-empty) -> TS fills non-null values where original is all NULL -> FP on IS NULL predicates.

sample_submission REAL constants 0.0833: Number fuzzer scale from REAL (no args) -> range [-1,1] floats, plausible magnitude but not 0.0833; distinct-1 columns become varied -> FP on equality/group-by.
